scope: Actual original app.js pinAuth and actAsync functions executed in a VM with the actual approved frontend service module over HTTP. UI elements and timers are controlled stand-ins, storage is in-memory, and the cross-tab lease provider is injected. This is not authenticated computer-browser testing or a reproduction of the user account.
passed: Actual frontend signs generated consumer A in.
Actual frontend signs generated consumer B in.
Both generated accounts have current server snapshots.
Generated account uses a four-digit created PIN.
Generated sender has the one pesewa required for the bounded test.
Wrong PIN is rejected by the real endpoint without invoking a payment.
Original PIN sheet displays the server rejection.
Wrong PIN leaves both test-account wallet balances unchanged.
Correct created PIN passes the actual PIN sheet and original payment callback.
Actual actAsync and shared transport confirm the one-pesewa payment.
Transient authorization PIN clears after the original continuation completes.
The original PIN sheet sent one wrong and one correct verification only.
Exactly one payment POST follows the corrected PIN.
Both consumers receive the same canonical one-pesewa ledger receipt.
The bounded successful payment debits and credits exactly one pesewa.
No generated login password is persisted by the frontend transport.
